results.summary: I verified all 41 requested rows, the 4 'verify' constraints, and spot-checked 10 additional open/item rows using git logs and gh pr/issue commands. I found two discrepancies where the ledger verdict should be updated: PMAT-622 (ProvableContract & `pmat work falsify` actually exist) and PMAT-707 (`--diff-scope` flag is exposed in `pmat analyze complexity` and present in the hook). Both should be fixed to 'completed'.
MACS-018 should be open (Anti-Gravity transcript parser not found). PMAT-707 should be completed (diff-scoped mode is reachable).
Found 2 discrepancies where the ledger verdict should change: MACS-018 (should be 'open') and PMAT-707 (should be 'completed'). All other verdicts were independently verified and agreed with.

consensus: All 3 lanes returned FAIL. Each finding's claim starts '<row> agree|disagree'; parsing those prefixes shows every lane judged all 43 rows (the 41 removing verdicts plus the open verify rows PMAT-622 and PMAT-707). Per-row tally: PMAT-707 open->completed 3/3 (the diff-scoped mode is reachable through `pmat analyze complexity --diff-scope` and the generated hook). MACS-018 completed->open 2/3 (lanes 2 and 3 found no parser that extracts Anti-Gravity transcript bounds; lane 1 agreed on the ground that 'its message documents the transcript bounds parser'). PMAT-622: lane 1 alone moves it to completed; lanes 2 and 3 keep it open because runner.rs says ProvableContract dispatch is 'not yet wired'. The other 40 rows are agreed 3/3: 19 completed (the 13 merged-PR rows plus MACS-017, MACS-019, PMAT-620, PMAT-624, PMAT-629, PMAT-654), 6 pair, 6 paired, 8 no-roadmap and #1240 close. Every spot-checked open or item row is agreed as-is (MACS-006, MACS-007, MACS-013, PMAT-619, PMAT-621, PMAT-632, #1014, #1074, #1118, #1119, #1120).
dissent: All 3 lanes are non-PASS, so lane_reduce.dissent carries all three verbatim. Minority positions inside the FAIL:
lane 1 alone: PMAT-622 -> completed ('Unified pmat work falsify and ProvableContract variant both exist'). Lanes 2 and 3 refute this with runner.rs 'not yet wired'.
lane 1 alone: MACS-018 stays completed, on the ground that the 'commit message documents the transcript bounds parser'. Lanes 2 and 3: no such parser exists.
